purpose: Partial strict-D closure for claimed live-page KEEP/KEEP or KEEP/REVISE Mathematics goals with exact rejected-revision dissent; excluded unresolved reviews and image holds remain open.

openGoals.note: Both independent current D rounds request an observable Newton-tangent mechanism and concrete limits; the current DE/EN target and inaccurate positive-only root alt text require correction, followed by a new page-bound D review.

openDisposition: No strict D closure, image acceptance, or human approval is inferred for excluded goals. Current dissent, unresolved earlier dissent, source-campaign drift, and image holds require separate targeted handling.
globalBookDigestDriftDisposition: Whole-book and subset digests are provenance, not an equivalence claim. Every claimed goal is rechecked against live canonical context, full GoalBook page, both review contexts and exact current image bytes. Image quality approval is not inferred.

unclaimedPageOrImageDrift.reason: current GoalBook page differs from the reviewed source campaign

sourceCampaignPageAndImagePreflight.meaning: Only claimed pages must equal their reviewed source pages and retain exact image bytes. Unclaimed drift is recorded, not accepted; this is no whole-campaign preflight pass, image-quality acceptance, or strict D closure for excluded goals.
